blurb: Classic Helicopter Services provides air medical transport with specialized critical care teams including nurses, paramedics, respiratory therapists, and physicians. They operate rotor and fixed wing aircraft as well as ground ambulances from over 20 air bases in 8 states. Services are available 24/7, 365 days a year, for local, national, and international patient transport.
